mapper.select: WHERE p.bsn_part_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF p
SELECT bsn_part_id::text AS id,bsn_part_nm AS name,hq_yn='Y' AS hq FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_seq,bsn_part_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_nm=#{name} AND bsn_part_id<>#{id})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_ym>=#{input.aply_bgn_ym}
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.bsn_part_std_hist SET aply_end_ym=#{previousMonth} WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_ym<#{input.aply_bgn_ym} AND (aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym>=#{input.aply_bgn_ym})
mapper.select: SELECT p.bsn_part_id::text AS bsn_part_id,p.bsn_part_nm,p.hq_yn,p.use_yn,p.sort_seq, CAST(#{month} AS text) AS "referenceMonth",s.ldr_nm AS "currentStandard.ldr_nm",s.prft_dstrb_rt AS "currentStandard.prft_dstrb_rt", s.bsn_fee_amt AS "currentStandard.bsn_fee_amt",s.aply_bgn_ym AS "currentStandard.aply_bgn_ym", (SELECT string_agg(h.aply_bgn_ym||'부터 '||h.prft_dstrb_rt||'%', ', ' ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym) FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist h WHERE h.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND h.aply_bgn_ym>#{month}) AS "scheduledChanges", (SELECT count(*) FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt>#{today})) AS "peopleCount", (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.prj j WHERE j.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND j.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')) AS "projectCount" FROM mst.bsn_part p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.ldr_nm,h.prft_dstrb_rt,h.bsn_fee_amt,h.aply_bgn_ym FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist h WHERE h.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND h.aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} AND (h.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR h.aply_end_ym>=#{month}) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE p.bsn_part_id IN #{id} ORDER BY p.sort_seq,p.bsn_part_id
